verdicts.reason: Both scramble the copy into 'PRAY / When Life Is Great / When Life Is Rough / PRAY', which destroys the original's two-couplet meaning. Both move the divider line to the bottom, where it points at nothing, and both crop the rose to a hard rectangle with the leaves sliced off on the left. 'When Life Is Rough' is shifted off the centre axis in both. A also shrinks the second PRAY and leaves a large dead area at the bottom. B gives the rose more presence, but its text block is jammed against the top edge. B is marginally less weak.
